I will put urea on this rice plot because without fertilizer the harvest is too small to pay the rent and feed my family, but I can only buy a small bag since money is tight. I will plant the improved SARO seed because it fills better and resists diseases more than the old local rice, and I will spray herbicide once to fight the weeds since my children have school and cannot weed by hand so many times. My wife and I will do most of the work ourselves, but I will hire three or four workers for about five days each when it is time to transplant and harvest so we finish before the rains stop. I will not irrigate because this plot is in a low area that stays damp from the stream and the seasonal rains, so the rice will have enough water.
